attributes.title: 63rd Annual SCCA Conference
attributes.series: South Carolina Counseling Association Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The South Carolina Counseling Association holds its 63rd annual conference February 17 to 19, 2027, in Myrtle Beach. The meeting brings together licensed professional counselors, school counselors, counselor educators and students from across the state, with live in-person presentations.

SCCA is approved by NBCC as a continuing education provider (ACEP No. 2041), and sessions that do not qualify for NBCC credit are marked as such. The total number of clock hours was not published yet.

Registration opened on September 1, 2026. The venue, fees and hotel details were not published on the conference page when we checked; a separate registration path exists for school counselors.
